name: DSCodeBench
description: DSCodeBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on realistic and complex data science code generation tasks using 1,000 problems sourced from GitHub across ten popular Python data science libraries. It features longer code solutions, comprehensive libraries, clear problem descriptions, and strong test suites to rigorously assess LLM capabilities in data science programming.
reputation: A new benchmark for data science code generation that is promising but not yet widely established in the broader coding-benchmark ecosystem.
notes: More challenging and representative than previous benchmarks, with robust scaling behavior and manual curation for evaluation reliability.
